flows.trigger: User submits registration + login form on the frontend
flows.outcome: New User row created (BCrypt-hashed password); login returns a signed JWT (1h expiry) that the frontend attaches as a Bearer token to subsequent requests

flows.trigger: Authenticated user creates an account and adds a transaction
flows.outcome: Account row created scoped to the caller's userId; Transaction row added under that account, updating its computed balance

flows.trigger: Authenticated user transfers money between two of their accounts
flows.outcome: Two offsetting Transaction rows plus one Transfer audit row are written atomically per request; a retried request with the same IdempotencyKey hits the unique index, catches DbUpdateException, and returns the original Transfer instead of double-processing

flows.trigger: Authenticated user creates a recurring schedule against one of their accounts
flows.outcome: SchedulesController verifies the target account belongs to the caller before persisting a new RecurringSchedule row

WebApplicationFactory<Program> boots the real ASP.NET pipeline with INTEGRATION_TEST=true, routing all connection-string selection to a throwaway per-run SQLite file so tests never touch Postgres/SQL Server
